correctness.rationale: The source gives the exact Brownian reset MFPT. In the zero-delay case its stability boundary becomes cosh(k)/cosh(bk)=1+k^2/C. The extracted entire-function coefficients are proportional to n(2n−1)−sum_{j=0}^{n−1}b^{−2j}; their sign changes once for C>5/2 by the monotone second-difference argument, proving a unique positive root. Sign bracketing at y=(1±epsilon)log C and log-domain inversion prove the stated two-term high-c expansion. The supplied checker passed 75 assertion groups, supplemental only.

value.rationale: The resource-planning threshold depends on the coupled limit of increasing server count and an ever-closer critical starting point. The exact asymptotic identifies a true regular-variation exponent of 2 with squared logarithmic correction, replacing a numerically fitted larger exponent and providing its physical prefactor and first log-log improvement. It is a quantitatively meaningful scale law, not a one-off parameter substitution.
